subject: [AMBER] Antechamber/acpype for ligand parametrization and usage of yasara autosmiles

messages.author: Prasanth G, Research Scholar
messages.body:
Dear all,
Can someone suggest a way to use yasara autosmiles generated file for
parametrizing ligands. I had seen a link, where vague details of how to use
acpype for this is given -
https://www.ccpn.ac.uk/v2-software/software/ACPYPE-folder/user-charge-options
We can save the pdb file from yasara scene files, that the server gives as
results. I am not sure on, how to convert this file into a meaningful mol2
file, such that acpype or antechamber can process it further.
Thank you.
-- 
Regards,
Prasanth.

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Apr 11, 2020, Prasanth G, Research Scholar wrote:
>We can save the pdb file from yasara scene files, that the server gives as
>results. I am not sure on, how to convert this file into a meaningful mol2
>file, such that acpype or antechamber can process it further.
A pdb file is all that antechamber needs, but it must have all
hydrogens.  See the instructions or tutorials for antechamber if you've
not done this before.  I'm not familiar with acpype, but you shouldn't
need that here.
....dac
